help.player2npc.cleanup-clones.short: Remove your own duplicate companion clones left behind by a dimension-change bug.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones.long: Scans every loaded dimension for a second copy of one of your companions that was accidentally spawned when you changed dimension. Only removes a clone that is loaded, provably not your active companion, and not currently running a task — your real companion and any companion that is merely out of a loaded chunk are never touched.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-player.sh: Operator: remove another player's duplicate companion clones.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-player.lo: Same safety rules as the self version, scoped to the named player's squad instead of your own. The target must be online.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-player.ar: The owning player whose duplicate companion clones are removed.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-all.short: Operator: remove duplicate companion clones for every online player.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-all.long: Runs the clone cleanup once per currently online player. Offline players are skipped (their canonical companion mapping cannot be safely resolved while they are offline).
